FOLIO Nº 1 — FOR MEMECOIN CALLERS & THE PEOPLE WHO FOLLOW THEM

The caller
buys with you,
not before you.

A caller seals the token in a hash and stakes SOL. Followers deposit blind. At reveal, one Solana transaction buys for everyone, caller included, at one price. Nobody can front-run a ticker they cannot see.

SEAL A CALL
